messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Writers in the HMC Code
parts:
I just spend the last there hours or so trying to incorporate all of the
changes needed to make the RHMC branch work with the added
error writers, and not the majority of the HMC code is passing around
these f’ing writers, most of which do nothing. When more writers
are added to implement logging it’s going to get even worse.

I really want to fix this soon to put the HMC code back in a clean
state. I imagine this would consist of

a) A logger object which wraps all of the necessary writers and
exposes methods like “write_info”, “writer_fatal”, etc.

b) Passing the logger to the samplers on construction.

c) Storing a reference to the input logger in the internal ps_point
instantiation so that when this->z_ is passed around so to is
the logger.

In this way the logging implementation can be tweaked without
affecting the HMC code.

Also, in the future please don’t merge updates that touch nearly
all of the HMC code without my review.
